name: notra
description: Turn shipped GitHub, Linear, and product work into changelogs, blog posts, and social updates with the Notra MCP server and content skills.

NOTRA_API_KEY.title: Notra API key
NOTRA_API_KEY.description: API key from the Notra dashboard under Developer → API Keys. Grant read and write access for posts, brand identities, integrations, schedules, chats, and skills. Optional until you generate content; set it under Customize → Notra → Configure.
